name: Jezero marginal carbonates
note: Carbonate-bearing unit lining western Jezero crater rim, prioritized for Perseverance sampling.

name: Jezero western delta phyllosilicates
note: Smectite-rich deltaic strata transported from Nili Fossae watershed.

name: Nili Fossae olivine-carbonate plains
note: Largest exposed regional carbonate-olivine province on Mars.

name: Mawrth Vallis layered phyllosilicates
note: Hundreds-of-meters-thick clay stratigraphy recording ancient pedogenesis/alteration.

name: Aeolis Mons (Mt Sharp) sulfate unit
note: Transition from clay-bearing strata to sulfate-bearing strata recording drying climate.

name: Candor Chasma interior sulfates
note: Kieserite-bearing interior layered deposits inside central Valles Marineris.

name: Meridiani Planum crystalline hematite
note: Gray hematite spherules over sulfate-rich sandstones mapped from orbit and ground.
citation: Christensen et al. (2000), JGR; Squyres et al. (2004), Science

name: Syrtis Major low-calcium/high-calcium pyroxene
note: Type locality for dark Martian basaltic shield volcanism.

name: Terra Sirenum chloride basin
note: Evaporite chloride deposits in southern highland basins.

name: Columbus crater alunite & kaolinite
note: Concentric paleolake shoreline mineralogy indicating acidic groundwater evaporation.

name: Home Plate opaline silica (Gusev)
note: High-purity (~90% SiO2) silica nodules interpreted as hydrothermal spring/fumarole deposits.

name: Noctis Labyrinthus hydrated silica & iron sulfates
note: Diverse hydrated minerals in western trough complexes.

name: Arcadia Planitia shallow ice scarps
note: Mid-latitude buried ice sheets verified via SHARAD dielectric contrast and fresh impact exposures.
citation: Bramson et al. (2015), GRL 42; Dundas et al. (2018), Science

name: Holden crater lacustrine phyllosilicates
note: Light-toned bedded clay-bearing mudstones deposited after Uzboi Vallis breach.

name: Eberswalde crater delta clays
note: Classic inverted meandering distributary delta containing smectite clays.
